claim.claim-text: (1) a hard segment in an amount of 10% to 60% by weight of the elastomeric polymer, the hard segment including a urethane, a urea, or a urethane urea; and (2) a soft segment in an amount of 40% to 90% by weight of the elastomeric polymer, the soft segment including: (a) 10% to 90% by weight of the soft segment of at least one polycarbonate macrodiol, wherein the polycarbonate macrodiol includes at least one poly(alkylene carbonate); and (b) 10 to 90% by weight of the soft segment of at least one polyisobutylene macrodiol and/or diamine;
wherein the number average molecular weight of the elastomeric polymer is not less than 40 kilodaltons, and wherein the polyisobutylene macrodiol is hydroxypropyl telechelic polyisobutylene.
2. The polymer of claim 1, wherein the number average molecular weight of the hydroxypropyl telechelic polyisobutylene is about 400 Da to about 6000 Da.
3. The polymer of claim 1 or 2, wherein the at least one poly(alkylene carbonate) is poly(hexamethylene carbonate).
4. The polymer of one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the hard segment is formed by reacting a diisocyanate with a chain extender.
5. The polymer of claim 4, wherein the diisocyanate is 4,4'-methylenephenyl diisocyanate and wherein the chain extender is 1,4-butanediol.
6. The polymer of one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the soft segment includes
i) 10% to 30% by weight of the soft segment of the at least one polycarbonate macrodiol, and ii) 70% to 90% by weight of the soft segment of the at least one polyisobutylene macrodiol and/or diamine.
